title: NorthPlay 2027 Business Strategy
text:
# NorthPlay 2027 Business Strategy
*Becoming Ontario's most trusted sportsbook*

Leadership Team | Confidential | v1.2 | October 14, 2026
> NorthPlay is a fictional operator. All figures are illustrative demo data.


## Slide 2: 2026 in review

- **212K**: active players (Oct 2026)
- **$41M**: net gaming revenue YTD
- **31%**: players with a limit set
- **$148**: avg. acquisition cost, up 38% YoY

- Live betting and the parlay builder now drive 54% of handle
- Acquisition costs rose sharply after Ontario's ban on public bonus advertising
- Two creative escalations from compliance in 2026, both tied to bonus language

## Slide 3: Market context

- Ontario is a mature, crowded regulated market with 45+ operators competing for the same players
- The regulator keeps tightening: athlete ban (Feb 2024), public inducement ban, closer scrutiny of 'free' offers
- Bonus-led acquisition is no longer a durable advantage; brand trust and product are
- Regulatory findings now carry real financial penalties and public reputational damage

## Slide 4: Our ambition

**Be the sportsbook Ontario adults trust most.**

- Mission: make following the game more fun, without putting players at risk
- North Star metric: 90-day retained players who have at least one NorthPlay Limits tool enabled
- We win on product and trust, not on bonuses

## Slide 5: Three strategic pillars

- **1. Trust-first brand**: Responsible gambling is our brand differentiator, not a disclaimer. Every touchpoint is factual, calm and compliant.
- **2. Product-led growth**: Invest in live betting, same-game parlays and micro-markets. Let features, not offers, sell the app.
- **3. Hockey-first**: Own NHL betting in Ontario. Hockey is ~40% of our handle and our strongest brand association.

## Slide 6: Who we serve

- Core: sports fans aged 25-54 in Ontario who already watch NHL, NFL and NBA
- We do not build campaigns aimed at 19-24 year olds; minimum targeting age is 25 on all paid channels
- We do not target lapsed players with re-activation offers
- Messaging assumes an experienced, entertainment-minded fan, not someone looking to make money

## Slide 7: Shifting the growth model

|  | 2026 | 2027 plan |
|---|---|---|
| Bonus-led acquisition | 45% of marketing budget | 10% (opted-in direct only) |
| Brand and product marketing | 35% | 60% |
| Retention and CRM | 20% | 30% |
| Target acquisition cost | $148 | $120 |

- All inducements move to on-site and consented direct channels only

## Slide 8: Responsible gambling as a differentiator

- Launch 'NorthPlay Limits', a single hub for deposit, time and loss limits (Q1 2027)
- Target: 40% of active players with a limit set by Dec 2027
- Retired CFL lineman Marcus Doyle stays on as Play Smart ambassador, for responsible gambling messaging only
- Publish an annual Player Protection Report

## Slide 9: 2027 roadmap

| Quarter | Product | Marketing |
|---|---|---|
| Q1 | NorthPlay Limits hub, faster live odds | Hockey Night Live; NFL playoffs; Play Smart refresh |
| Q2 | Micro-markets for NHL playoffs | NHL playoff campaign; NBA playoffs |
| Q3 | Personalized odds feed | Football kickoff; brand platform refresh |
| Q4 | Parlay builder v2 | Holiday hockey; Player Protection Report |

## Slide 10: Risks and guardrails

- Regulatory risk: any finding damages the trust-first strategy. Zero tolerance on compliance shortcuts
- All creative is reviewed by the Legal Approver Agent before trafficking; target turnaround under 24 hours
- Legal decisions made in #legal-marketing are binding and take effect immediately, even before decks are updated
- Partner and ambassador use requires a current, signed agreement

## Slide 11: 2027 targets

- **260K**: active players
- **$58M**: net gaming revenue
- **40%**: players with a limit set
- **0**: regulatory findings

title: Q1 2027 Marketing & Brand Plan
text:
# Q1 2027 Marketing & Brand Plan
*Hockey Night Live, NFL playoffs and the Play Smart refresh*

Marketing Team | Internal | v1.0 | October 28, 2026
> NorthPlay is a fictional operator. All figures are illustrative demo data.


## Slide 2: Q1 objectives

- Grow active players to 225K (+6% QoQ)
- Launch the NorthPlay Limits hub with a responsible gambling brand campaign
- Own hockey: be the most-recalled sportsbook brand among Ontario NHL fans
- Keep acquisition cost under $130 with no public bonus advertising

## Slide 3: Campaign calendar

| Campaign | Dates | Focus |
|---|---|---|
| Hockey Night Live | Jan 3 - Mar 28 | Live odds, NHL micro-markets |
| NFL Playoffs + the Big Game | Jan 9 - Feb 7 | Parlay builder, live betting |
| Play Smart refresh | Jan 15 - Feb 28 | NorthPlay Limits launch, Marcus Doyle |
| Basketball tip-off | Feb 13 - Mar 31 | Player props |

## Slide 4: Channel mix and budget

| Channel | Q1 budget | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Meta (Instagram, Facebook) | $1.1M | Square and story formats |
| YouTube and CTV | $0.9M | 15s and 30s video |
| Programmatic display | $0.5M | Adult-verified inventory only |
| TikTok and Snapchat | $0.3M | 25+ targeting |
| Radio and podcast | $0.4M | Sports talk, hockey pods |
| Email and SMS (opted-in) | $0.1M | Only channel for offers |

## Slide 5: Brand voice

- **We are**: Confident, factual, calm, fan-first. We talk about the game, the odds and the product.
- **We never**: Use hype or certainty words ('lock', 'easy money', 'guaranteed'), slang, urgency ('last chance'), or talk about money outcomes.
- **We always**: Show odds as information, include the full disclaimer, and assume an experienced adult fan.

## Slide 6: Visual identity

- Palette: Deep Navy #06141F, Rink Green #145C4A, Mint #7FE0C4. No neon, pink or orange gradients
- Typography: Inter / Inter Display
- No cartoon characters or mascots
- No people who look under 25. Hands, crowds and arenas are preferred over faces
- Logo: the NorthPlay arrow and wordmark, always top-left

## Slide 7: Messaging pillars

- **Every play, live**: Live odds and in-game betting for hockey fans
- **Built for the game**: Parlay builder, props, micro-markets
- **Play smart**: NorthPlay Limits, taking breaks, setting a budget

## Slide 8: Ambassadors and partnerships

- Marcus Doyle (retired CFL lineman): Play Smart ambassador, responsible gambling messaging only, no odds or betting CTAs in his creative
- No other athlete ambassadors in Q1
- Team and league marks may only be used under a signed license. We hold no NHL or NFL licenses
- Influencer and creator partnerships are not planned for Q1

## Slide 9: Mandatory creative elements

- Full disclaimer on every asset: '19+. Ontario only. Please play responsibly. Concerned about your gambling? Contact ConnexOntario 1-866-531-2600.'
- Minimum disclaimer size: 24px on 1080x1080 and 1080x1920; 18px on 1200x628
- Audio: the disclaimer is read at normal pace, never sped up
- Offers appear only in opted-in email/SMS and on-site, with full terms at first presentation

## Slide 10: Approval workflow

- 1. Creative team uploads the asset to the Legal Approver Agent
- 2. Agent returns approve / approve with changes / reject, with cited rules and precedents
- 3. Rejections are escalated to Legal (#legal-marketing) only if the team disputes them
- 4. Nothing is trafficked without an approval ID
- Turnaround target: under 24 hours
